verdict.rationale: Background automation (scheduled jobs, batch pipelines, triggers or webhooks) is a fair axis for a document-processing API platform, but the evidence covers only synchronous OCR, annotation and QnA calls through SDKs. Mentions of 'automated accounting' describe use cases, not a feature that runs autonomously. The llms.txt reference to Agents & Conversations concerns the broader Mistral platform and shows no background-automation capability for Document AI.
